newsitem.title: USA: Vectra puts hold on fabrication activity.
newsitem.headline: Vectra puts hold on fabrication activity.

text.p: Vectra Technologies Inc, a technology and service provider to the nuclear power industry, on Wednesday said it put a hold on fabrication activities for its nuclear material transportation and storage technologies.

The move specifically relates to its NUHOMS and UX-30 products. NUHOMS is used for storing spent nuclear fuel, and UX-30 is used in the shipment of uranium hexafluoride used in the manufacturing of nuclear fuel.
Vectra said it has sold its low-level radioactive waste service and would take a $5.9 million charge as a result.
